summary: Opens the 个股 (individual stocks) section: trade stocks only after reading the index trend; in the first wave off a market bottom almost everything rises (deep-fallen low-priced turnaround stocks the most), while in a bear 覆巢之下无完卵; build a 3-5 stock basket, commit ≥50% with strict stops when the trend is clear, then add rotation stocks. Then three complete Taiwan case studies chaining the book's patterns with exact measured-move arithmetic and entry/stop/risk/profit: 华泰 1997-98 daily (头肩顶 → 两波跌幅满足 → 上飘旗形 → W底 → 两波涨幅满足 → M头), 联电 1997-98 daily (带量突破 → 涨幅满足 → 假突破 → 头肩顶 → 两波跌幅满足 → 破底翻), 友讯 1998-2001 weekly (头肩底 → 两波涨幅满足 → 头肩顶 → 跌幅满足 → 破底翻), and the start of 茂矽 1998-2001 weekly (收敛三角形底部 target 290+255=545, continued in the next unit). A 小叮咛 notes that H&S targets and plain swing (波段) targets usually land in about the same place.

patterns.name_zh: 头肩顶（等幅跌幅满足，两波）
patterns.name_en: Head-and-shoulders top, measured downside targets (two waves)
patterns.structure: Three heads, the middle highest; neckline through the reaction lows (horizontal in 华泰, rising in 联电/友讯). Distance D = head high - neckline level (measured at the head). Confirmed when price breaks the neckline (华泰 9/1; 联电 9/2 gap long black; 友讯 7/1 week).
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks the neckline (跌破颈线时空单进场): 华泰 ≈40, 联电 ≈33, 友讯 ≈28.3.
patterns.stop: Reclaiming the neckline (站上颈线反压): 华泰 42 (5%), 联电 35 (6%), 友讯 30 (6%).

target.formula: target_1 = neckline_break_level - (head - neckline); target_2 = target_1 - same distance (after a rebound and a new low below the prior low)

confirmation: Neckline break (long black / gap down candle).
A sharp bounce the day after the break that fails to reclaim the neckline is the technical 'escape line' (逃命线).
Second-wave target is computed only after the bounce fails and price breaks the prior low (再破前低).
invalidation: Close back above (站回) the neckline.

patterns.structure: After the first downside target is reached (华泰 low 30.81), a rising channel rebound (high 37.38).
patterns.entry: A long black candle breaking the flag's lower line (10/17), and the next day a break of the prior low 30.81, triggers the next target computation.
patterns.stop: Not stated separately (the original short's neckline stop applies).
confirmation: 长黑破线 (long black candle through the flag line) and a new low below the prior low.

patterns.structure: Two lows (华泰 21.70 and 22.02, midpoint ~21.85) under a horizontal neckline 29 (high 29.22); ~3-month base.
patterns.stop: ≈28, i.e. a break of neckline support, which is also the low of that day's long red candle (risk ≈5%).

target.formula: target_1 = neckline + (neckline - bottoms_mid); target_2 = target_1 + same distance

confirmation: Scale: when a ~3-month base reaches target_1 within ~1 week, compute target_2 directly.

patterns.structure: After reaching the second upside target, wide-range topping (华泰 highs 42.59 mid-Feb, 45.76 early Apr; midpoint ~44); rising neckline ~33.2 (low 32.62).

patterns.name_zh: 波段涨幅满足（低点至高点等幅）
patterns.structure: First wave from a low to a high (联电 13.05 → 25.67, +12.62); pullback low 22.1; once price makes a new high, project the first wave from the pullback low.
patterns.entry: Original entry: 1997-05-29 volume breakout of the neckline (带量突破颈线) ≈16.
patterns.stop: 15, i.e. falling back below the line (risk ≈6.2%).
confirmation: Compute only after price makes a new high above the wave-1 high (再创新高).
invalidation: Falling back below the breakout line.

patterns.structure: After the target and a big-range top, price makes a record high (联电 40.19 on 8/4) above the range high, and the next day falls back below the breakout line.
patterns.entry: Sell longs / long-term sell signal on the day price falls back under the breakout neckline.

target.formula: n.a. (the subsequent H&S gives the target)

confirmation: Next-day fall back below the broken level.

patterns.entry: Weekly high-volume long red through the neckline (2000-01-08 week): buy ≈21.5.

target.formula: target_1 = breakout_level + (neckline_at_head - head_low); target_2 = target_1 + same distance

confirmation: Second target computed after crossing the prior high (越过前高).

rules.rule: Read the index trend before trading stocks; trading with the trend greatly raises the success rate, so trend-following stock selection matters.
rules.quote_zh: 先了解大盘的趋势，再介入个股操作，将会大幅提高成功率。因此随势选股非常重要。

rules.rule: In the first wave off a market bottom nearly all stocks rise; deep-fallen low-priced turnaround stocks usually rise the most. From the second wave on, stock picking is harder and volume-price patterns help.
rules.quote_zh: 当大盘脱离底部进入大波段起涨时，尤其是第一波段，几乎是鸡犬升天、涨多涨少的问题而已。从经验上看，起涨第一波，跌深的低价转机股通常涨幅最为惊人。

rules.rule: In a bear structure nearly every stock falls; tops usually complete when the market is least vigilant; volume-price structure lets you sell first or even reverse to short.
rules.quote_zh: 反之，进入空头的结构，状况大多是覆巢之下无完卵的。一般头部的完成，多半是在市场最无戒心的时候。

rules.rule: All pattern variations are built on volume-price structure; the first-half 12 methods suffice to judge both index and stocks.
rules.quote_zh: 不过切记，无论型态如何变化都是建立在量价结构的基础上。

rules.rule: Position sizing: hold a 3-5 stock basket, never one stock; when the trend is fairly certain commit ≥50% of capital per risk tolerance with strict stops; add rotation stocks once profitable, so that even full exposure rides the swing trend.
rules.quote_zh: 个股的多方趋势或空方趋势操作，至少要建立三至五档组合，切忌单压个股，有较大把握的趋势成形时，按个人的风险承受能力，先投入五成以上资金并严设停损。趋势若如预期，个股扩大获利时，再加码轮动股即可

rules.rule: Paul Tudor Jones: focus on not losing money more than on making it; protect your gains.
rules.quote_zh: 相对于赚钱，我比较注意赔钱。别光想赚钱，要专注于保护你的战果。

rules.rule: Neckline break of a three-head H&S top confirms it and allows computing the downside target.
rules.quote_zh: 华泰日线1997年9月1日跌破颈线，三尊头型态的头肩顶确立便可计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: After the first target, a long black breaking the up-flag and a next-day new low below the prior low allow computing the second target.
rules.quote_zh: 同年10月17日长黑破线上飘旗形确立，隔日再破30.81元前低，便可再计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Scale rule: a ~3-month base that hits target_1 about one week after breakout justifies computing target_2 directly.
rules.quote_zh: 华泰约三个月的底部突破约一周，便达涨幅满足附近，就规模而言，可直接计算第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Short on the neckline break with stop on reclaiming the neckline; if the backtest fails, cover near the downside targets.
rules.quote_zh: 1997年9月1日跌破头肩顶颈线时，空单进场，约可空在40元附近，停损设在42元附近，也就是站上颈线反压，风险约5%，反压站不回，看跌幅满足附近，空单回补获利

rules.rule: Long on the W neckline breakout; stop at the break of neckline support, which is also the low of the breakout day's long red candle.
rules.quote_zh: 1998年1月20日突破W底颈线，多单进场，约可买在29.5元，停损设在28元附近，也就是跌破颈线支撑，也是当日长红低点风险约5%。

rules.rule: Many patterns (e.g. H&S) can be targeted either with the pattern measured move or a plain swing measured move; they usually land in about the same place; when the H&S is complete (like 华泰), use the H&S computation as primary.
rules.quote_zh: 有许多型态，如华泰的头肩顶型态，除了计算头肩顶型态的跌幅满足外，也可用波段跌幅满足做计算，大多会落在大约的位置上，只是如华泰有相当完整的头肩顶型态，便会以头肩顶为主计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Livermore: big money is in the big trend, not daily fluctuations; determine the trend.
rules.quote_zh: 大钱不存在于股票的日常小波动，大钱只存在大势之内。因此你需要判定大势的走向。

rules.rule: Compute the swing target after price makes a new high above the first wave.
rules.quote_zh: 联电日线1997年首波涨至6月下旬拉回，7月初再创新高时便可计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: A record high followed the next day by a fall back below the breakout neckline is a 假突破 — a long-term sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 8月4日创40.19元历史新高，隔日便拉回突破的颈线以下，技术面假突破确立长线卖出信号。

rules.rule: After a neckline break, a sharp next-day bounce that fails to clear the neckline is the technical escape line (last chance to exit).
rules.quote_zh: （注意：破线隔日急弹未突破颈线为技术面的逃命线。）

rules.rule: Second downside wave: after a short bounce from target_1, a fall that breaks the prior low allows computing target_2 = target_1 - distance.
rules.quote_zh: 联电9月15日达跌幅满足附近，短弹几日后回跌再破前低，便可计算第二波跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Volume breakout of the neckline: long, stop on falling back below the line.
rules.quote_zh: 1997年5月29日带量突破颈线，多单进场，约可买在16元附近，停损设15元也就是跌落线下时，风险约6.2%，达涨幅满足获利约117%。

rules.rule: A weekly high-volume long red through the neckline of a ~1.5-year H&S bottom confirms it.
rules.quote_zh: 2000年1月8日友讯周线当周带量长红，突破颈线，约一年半的大头肩底确立，便可计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Speculative bubbles produce V-reversals at the second target: price falls as fast as it rose.
rules.quote_zh: V型反转，股价急转直下，反映当时友讯搭上网络泡沫的末班车后，随着泡沫戳破，股价怎么上去怎么下来的投机走势。

rules.rule: Use adjusted (还原权值) prices for charts after capital reductions; levels are given in adjusted terms with the then-actual prices noted.
rules.quote_zh: 茂矽周线（图示为茂矽几次减资后的还原权值图）1999年9月4日带量突破颈线，逾一年半的底部确立便可计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Triangle bottom target: triangle side length (first high to low) added to the breakout level.
rules.quote_zh: 三角形边长的高点420元至低点约在165元，距离255元。突破颈线的位置约在290元+255元＝等幅计算的涨幅满足545元。

worked_examples.pattern: 头肩底 → 两波涨幅满足 → 头肩顶 → 跌幅满足 → 破底翻

quantifiable: Index-trend gate: only take long stock setups when the index is in a confirmed uptrend (e.g. after an index bottom breakout); in an index bear structure prefer exits/shorts.
Portfolio rule: 3-5 concurrent names per trend trade; initial exposure ≥50% only after trend confirmation; add rotation names only when open positions are in profit.
H&S top target: D = head_high - neckline_value_at_head; target_1 = neckline_break_price - D; if price bounces then closes below the target_1-area low, target_2 = target_1 - D.
W bottom target: D = neckline - mean(low1, low2); target_1 = neckline + D; target_2 = target_1 + D (compute target_2 immediately if target_1 is hit within ~1/12 of the base duration).
Swing target: after a new high above wave-1 high, target = pullback_low + (wave1_high - wave1_low).
Triangle-bottom target: target = breakout_price + (first_high - first_low) of the triangle.
False breakout: new N-bar/record high followed within 1 bar by a close back below the breakout level → exit-long signal.
Escape line: after a neckline breakdown, if the next bar(s) bounce but close below the neckline, treat as the last exit for longs.
Stops: long = close below the broken neckline / breakout-day long-red low; short = close back above the neckline; typical risk 5-6.2% in these examples.
Volume confirmation: breakout bar volume clearly above recent average (带量); weekly breakouts in particular.
Use split/capital-reduction-adjusted price series for pattern levels.
ambiguities: 华泰 long profits '22% / 42%' (p175): from 29.5, 36.15 is +22.5% but 43.3 is +46.8%, so '42%' does not match the stated target (maybe exit below target or typo).
联电 short second-wave profit '52%' (p178): (33 - 16.22) / 33 ≈ 50.8%; close but not exact.

Head-to-neckline distance is measured to the neckline at the head's position, but the projection starts from the actual break level (34 for 联电, 28.5 for 友讯) when the neckline slopes; for 华泰 the neckline is horizontal so both equal 40.6.
The 小叮咛 diagram legend (p176) says '实线=头肩顶两波段涨幅满足' although it is a downside projection — presumably 跌幅满足.
茂矽 2001 low: text says 170.64 (p181) while the chart label reads 170.54 (the right axis shows 170.64).
友讯 overshot its downside target (9.69 vs 10.56, ~8%) before the 破底翻; 'near the target' tolerance is not defined.
破底翻 entries/stops are not given for 联电/友讯 in this unit — only 'bottom confirmed, big rebound'.
The 'bear: 覆巢之下无完卵' and 'first-wave low-priced turnaround stocks rise most' statements are experience-based, without quantification.
